mechanism: Both drugs are nephrotoxic and ototoxic; amikacin is an aminoglycoside with significant renal toxicity and voriconazole can impair renal function, increasing amikacin accumulation and toxicity risk.
action: Monitor renal function closely (baseline and regular BUN/creatinine), assess hearing, maintain adequate hydration, consider alternative antifungal if possible, and adjust amikacin dosing based on renal parameters.
